checks: Legacy preferences remain byte-for-byte unchanged and loading an empty conversation creates no history file.
Current-bar help uses the exact written-score lesson and local history source, with no model request or generation controls even when the model is available.
English and Chinese searches retain separate arrangements; a follow-up selects the second prior choice and opens it paused.
Explicit seek, phrase repeat, and slower commands update the real paused controls; invalid bars and missing pieces do not invent or change a score.
Opening chat releases held notes; textarea typing, composition Enter, Shift+Enter, and MIDI cannot play or advance; Tab stays inside and Escape restores launcher focus.
Transcript order, IDs, text and action choices survive closing the panel and reloading the app without duplicating exchanges.
A failed history save keeps both messages visible with an honest status; Retry saves the same messages without duplicates.
Editing a saved score disables its old conversation action; a fresh search creates an enabled action for the updated score.
A controlled model stream renders progressive text, sends a bounded current-piece excerpt, persists the completed reply and cannot execute practice actions while pending.

Stop and closing the dialog abort the stream, preserve clearly marked partial replies and reject late chunks; retry replaces the partial response without duplicating the user's question, and changing the piece disables stale retries.
Chat composer and transcript fit desktop, narrow and short windows, long drafts wrap, reduced motion disables decoration, and all three library screens avoid horizontal overflow.
A failed initial history read disables sending and preserves the stored conversation; Retry restores it, and the piano still exposes 88 keys and a reachable Play control.
